agent_action.rationale: This visits Baton Rouge and New Orleans and uses only supported self-driving routes. In Baton Rouge, two distinct private rooms are needed because each selected listing accommodates only one person; Artist Loft is billed for one night ($979) and Spectacular apartment is billed for its two-night minimum ($220). The New Orleans private room accommodates two but requires three nights ($1,239). None of these listings states a No-parties rule. Lodging is therefore $2,438, transport is $124, and listed restaurant meals are approximately $320 for two, producing a known total of $2,882. The $1,500 budget is not met by $1,382, and packed-food costs, attraction admission, and local movement remain unpriced. The final day intentionally omits an attraction and lodging because it is devoted to the supported 10-hour-27-minute return drive to Charlotte.
